title: The “police report” link
scenario: A rental-company employee emails after your trip saying local police require an online statement for a traffic incident involving your car. The link asks for your licence, passport and card details before it shows the report.

answers.A: Open your rental account or contact the rental company through your contract details and ask whether any incident is attached to the rental.
answers.B: Ask for the police case number and agency, then verify the case with that agency independently.
answers.C: Complete only the identity fields first and stop if the site later asks for payment.

explanation: A legitimate incident can still be used as bait. Verify the case before uploading a complete identity bundle.
